values.note: recreation.gov charges $28 a site (2026 and 2027 tables, no weekend surcharge); the Forest Service page and its 2026 fee sheet say $30 a night, with 'rates differ between weekdays/weekends'. One RV with tow per site; an extra vehicle pays a nightly fee collected at the campground. Senior pass discount on single sites.

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232357 ('Electrical hook-ups are not available') + catalog (all 28 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 21 back-in and 6 pull-through RV sites (one pop-up/tent site); per-site lengths 30, 35 or 40 ft on recreation.gov (6 at 40 ft). The Forest Service fee sheet lists '28/60''; level parking areas.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id:232357 + RIDB catalog (28 sites; Max Vehicle Length 30 x11, 35 x11, 40 x6; Driveway Entry Back-In 21, Pull-Through 6) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/north-fork-campground ('28 sites with picnic tables, fire rings, level parking areas, and food lockers'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Bear-proof food lockers at every site and bear-proof trash; firewood sold on site. Water is shut off after September 30.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232357 ('vault toilets, and drinking water'; 'Bear-proof food lockers are provided at each site'; 'Firewood is available on-site') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/north-fork-campground ('Potable water is available at this site') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 ('Water will not be provided after 9/30'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 2026 estimated dates May 13 - November 2; the late season depends on weather and road conditions.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 ('2026 Campground and Day Use Area Operating Dates ... These are estimated opening dates'; 'North Fork CG ... 5/13-11/2*'; '*If season extends into October or November it is weather and road condition dependent'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Reservable 'Peak Season' 2027: May 13 - October 31 (2026 ran to November 1, with sites booked through the October hunting seasons). Book at least 2 days ahead. 14 nights a stay and 14 a month. The site must be occupied the first night; a reservation is forfeited if not occupied by 11 a.m. the day after arrival. Group site currently closed.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232357 (rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 14 'Each Month', reservationCutOff 2, minWeekendStay 0, minHolidayWeekendStay 0; notices on first-night occupancy, forfeiture, group site closed) + /rates (Peak Season 2027-05-13 to 2027-10-31; 2026-05-13 to 2026-11-01) + October 2026 availability (sites 'Reserved' through October), read 2026-10-27

note: Blanco RD (White River NF) campground at 7,800 ft, 32 mi up County Road 8 from Meeker, in an aspen grove on a bench above the North Fork of the White River (across the road). Fly fishing on the river; OHV routes and Flat Tops trailheads nearby. Livestock may graze in the area. --Claude
